content_text:
Hi Roger,
I’m glad I found this website and have the opportunity to chat with you. I’m a student currently applying to film school, and I’ve already gained some experience in the student crew. However, I’m worried about how to transition from being a student to becoming a qualified cinematographer, as the scales of the two seem completely different. If possible, could you talk about how you made this transition?
